summary: Tested Admin Customer CRUD (create/edit/impersonate/delete) + button contrast fix. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing. Frontend: full lifecycle works, Create a Customer button is a visible blue/white button (bg=rgb(37,99,235), color=rgb(255,255,255)) — NOT invisible. No white-on-white elements detected on Customers page.

issues: Console warns: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y warning, not blocking)

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the customer create/edit and delete-confirm DialogContent to silence a11y console warnings.
Optional: Add a GET /api/admin/customers endpoint or rely on /api/store/customers (currently used by the UI) — GET /api/admin/customers returns 405.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend AdminCustomers.jsx uses GET /api/store/customers for listing while create/edit/delete/impersonate use /api/admin/customers — endpoint namespacing is inconsistent but functional.
DELETE /api/admin/customers/{id} only deletes user with role USER; safe. update_customer allows changing email without re-verification (admin-only endpoint, acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a unique customer (test_cust_<uuid>@example.com and qa_ui_<ts>@example.com) and cleans them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests cover: create (200), duplicate email (400), created customer can login (proves account works platform-wide), appears in /store/customers list, edit fields+password, impersonate returns token, delete removes both users+customers docs, impersonate after delete=404, and old create-test endpoint removed. Frontend Playwright verified the blue Create a Customer button, dialog form (data-testid customer-form-*), edit/delete row buttons, confirm-delete-customer, and toast confirmation.
rca of the issue: N/A - previously reported contrast bug (invalid Tailwind arbitrary values with spaces) is fixed; button now renders as bg-blue-600 with white text and is clearly visible.
